meta_description: Die-level reverse engineering of the Nintendo DMG-CPU SoC (Game Boy): wiki, die photographs, netlists and die-perfect Verilog with Icarus regression suites.

hero.title: DMG-CPU
hero.lede: The DMG-CPU is the system-on-a-chip of the original Nintendo Game Boy. This project rebuilds it from silicon: modules are traced from die photographs with the Deroute utility into netlists and die-perfect Verilog — and the real netlists are exercised by Icarus regression suites for the SM83 core, PPU, APU and the small clock/arbiter/MMIO/serial domain.
